capabilities: Record habit check-ins as tags in daily note files
Show per-habit check-in counts and streak lengths
Visualize the last 7 days of check-ins as dots
Filter records by week or month
Configure habit keywords, display names, and app name
extras: README is written in Chinese; includes an FAQ section and a WeChat donation request. Requires diary files named yyyy-mm-dd.md (default journals directory) with tag-format check-ins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to aggregate habit check-ins recorded as tags in daily notes into streaks, statistics, and a visual overview.
summary: Habit tracker that reads habit tags from dated diary files and shows habit lists, streaks, and 7-day check-in dots.
